cards.text: It's the eighth month of the second year of Darius, king of Persia (Ezra 4:24), and the word of the LORD comes to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo. That's a full name AND a family tree, friend. My whole name is five letters the Millers carved into my handle.

cards.question: Before anything else, the LORD tells Zechariah how He felt about the people's fathers. True or false: He was very pleased with them.

cards.text: So the LORD of Hosts gives Zechariah a message to pass on to the people. Zechariah is now the one posting the big update in the group chat and watching for those little 'seen' checkmarks.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts tells Zechariah what the people should do and what He will do in response. What does He say?

answers.text: They return to Him and He returns to them
They bring offerings and He forgives them
They rebuild His house and He blesses them

cards.text: Then the LORD warns them: 'Do not be like your fathers…' The former prophets brought those fathers a message from the LORD of Hosts: 'Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.'

cards.question: The former prophets told the fathers to turn from their evil ways and deeds. How did the fathers respond?

cards.text: Then God asks two questions: 'Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?'

cards.question: God has asked where the fathers are now and whether the prophets live forever. Next, He asks whether something of His overtook the fathers. What does He name?
True or false: when the LORD's words and statutes caught up with the fathers, they repented.
When they repented, the fathers said the LORD of Hosts did to them just what He ___ to do, according to their ways and deeds.
